title: About Me
subtitle: Who I am
paragraphs: I'm a chemistry-trained environmental scientist with four years of hands-on experience in analytical chemistry (AAS, INAA, HPGe gamma spectrometry), project data management and stakeholder coordination.

My research focuses on heavy metals, PFAS, radioactivity and industrial chemical contamination in Bangladesh's rivers, soils, road dust and food. I enjoy bridging the lab and the real world — translating technical findings into clear reports for managers, partners and policymakers.
